notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6); fund balances are cash balances. Taxes 304,004 split by tax type and Intergovernmental 380,455 split into its printed pieces, both from the fund budget schedules (p11-27). The General Fund summary budget schedule (p10) is superseded by the detailed receipts/disbursements schedules (p11-14), so p10 lines are not in detail.
